title: The Dragon's Math Cave
description: A dragon has locked the village treasure! Solve math problems to unlock the cave and save the day!
subject: Math

questions.question: What is 24 x 6?
questions.hint: Try breaking it up — 20 x 6 plus 4 x 6!

questions.question: What is 156 ÷ 4?
questions.hint: How many times does 4 go into 156?

questions.question: What is 1,250 + 875?
questions.hint: Add the hundreds first, then the rest!

questions.question: A dragon has 48 gold coins and splits them equally among 6 knights. How many coins does each knight get?
questions.hint: This is a division problem — 48 divided by 6!
